command:
cat > /private/tmp/agent-100/example-project/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/scratchpad/wq-check.sql <<'EOF'
WITH q AS (
  SELECT q.id, q.workflow_id, q.workflow_type,
         CASE WHEN q.resolution_message_values IS JSON OBJECT THEN q.resolution_message_values::jsonb END AS v
  FROM queues_work_queue_items.work_queue_item q
  WHERE q.resolution_message_type_name = 'Example.Modules.Imports.Domain.DataImportBatches.Workflows.ResolveImportValidationErrorCommand'
), c AS (
  SELECT q.*,
    (v IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(v->'dataImportItemId')='number' AND (v->>'dataImportItemId') ~ '^[0-9]+$') AS item_ok,
    coalesce(v->>'workflowId', v #>> '{workflowId,value}') AS wf_text
  FROM q
)
SELECT coalesce(c.workflow_type,'<null>') AS wtype,
  count(*) AS n,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT item_ok) AS bad_item_json,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.workflow_id IS NULL) AS no_workflow_id,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE wf_text IS NULL OR wf_text !~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$' OR wf_text::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM c.workflow_id) AS wf_mismatch,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE item_ok AND i.id IS NULL) AS orphaned_item,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.type='external_hub' AND b.source_type=1) AS target,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.type='email' AND b.source_type<>1) AS keep_email
FROM c
LEFT JOIN imports.contract_import_items i ON c.item_ok AND i.id = (c.v->>'dataImportItemId')::bigint
LEFT JOIN imports.contract_import_batches b ON b.id = i.contract_import_batch_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
EOF
